findings: Changes are immediate; LTR values grow left-to-right and RTL reverses this. Vertical standard sliders place the minimum below the maximum.
Range sliders are recommended horizontally; vertical range is discouraged for cognitive load, not described as a runtime prohibition.
External numeric fields must track the same value and should follow the slider in Tab order.
Value indicators are optional if the value appears elsewhere. Range indicators display one handle value at a time.
Inset icons and five visual sizes are optional M3 capabilities, not approved additions to the house interface.
Focus enters on the handle; name normally matches adjacent text; native slider role and appropriate feedback are required.
Inactive-track endpoints need a 3:1 visual anchor if the track itself lacks that contrast. Stop indicators or external icons can supply the anchor.
The keyboard table lists Tab, arrows, Space plus arrows, Home and End. Space-modifier guidance differs from the approved house Shift/Page large-step behavior and from the native Web implementation.
External stepper icons have button semantics; they must not be treated as decorative if actionable.

validatorCoverage.proof: Slider imports form-associated and element-internals mixins but no validator or constraint-validation module. The reviewed tree lists Checkbox, Radio, Select and Text Field validators; native range inputs provide Slider snapping/sanitization.

findings.finding: One scalar or two range values; no orientation property, arbitrary-length value array or minimum-gap setting. Native range inputs are the actual pointer/key interaction targets, separate from visual handles.

Native min/max remain global for geometry, while aria-valuemin/max expose neighboring values. The implementation clamps crossing and switches coincident pointer targets when needed; keyboard interaction cannot flip targets.

Reads valueAsNumber after rendering to align drawn handles to native snapping. Unset single value derives from the browser range value; unset pair defaults near one-third/two-thirds. These defaults differ from house [0].

Passes live native input and redispatches noncomposed change. Suppresses unchanged/clamped keyboard changes. Firefox pointerup ordering waits one animation frame; Safari release explicitly focuses input.

setFormValue runs synchronously from requestUpdate. name/disabled use synchronous attributes. Native associated labels are exposed as NodeList. formDisabledCallback writes disabled, which is not the house separation of authored and platform-disabled state.

Serializes a range using FormData and reset values from attributes. Restores range entry arrays versus scalar state. This is a source comparison, not proof that all browsers restore the same state shape.
Explicitly does not support ID-reference attributes such as aria-labelledby or aria-controls. Preserve the house semantic element-reference bridge rather than copying this limitation.
Slider action logic has no pointercancel/lostpointercapture handler of its own. Browser-native interaction and Ripple cancellation do not prove the full house canceled-gesture commit contract.

FocusRing follows native focus-visible and attaches by control/for. Ripple filters initiating primary pointer, distinguishes touch delay, handles cancellation, and uses Web Animations with timed easing. Controllers remove control listeners on detach; this is not house Lit spring behavior.

Overlaid transparent range inputs receive pointer events; midpoint clipping chooses the nearer range endpoint. Includes RTL clipping, native-engine thumb geometry, forced-colors-specific tracks/ticks, and reduced-motion label treatment.

Actually imported component tokens are v0.192: 4px tracks, 20px circular handle, 40px state layer and 28px value label container. Source CSS gives focus ring 48px. New latest token files are not automatically used by this component.
Published token generation 34.0.21 contains current thin handles, thicker tracks, size sets and deprecation flags. It is token availability, not a shipped Expressive Slider implementation.

radix.read: complete Slider source; public docs API/examples/keyboard/caveats
findings: Supports both orientations, RTL, arrays, step and minimum gap. preserveThumbOrder clamps between neighbors; default otherwise sorts values.
Uses pointer capture, nearest-value selection, changed-gesture commit and immediate keyboard commit. No pointercancel handler exists in the reviewed implementation.
Shift/Page moves ten steps; Home moves first value and End last value in the root implementation. These details are comparison evidence, not automatic house behavior.
Semantic thumbs use slider roles; hidden form inputs are separate. Native house range semantics and one root submission owner remain the proposed approach.

chakra.read: complete main documentation content and prop table during preceding preparation turn
findings: Array values produce range sliders. Default collision behavior none prevents passing; push and swap are opt-in.
Documents separate live and end callbacks, per-thumb accessible labels, orientation, minimum gaps and composed controlled state.
largeStep defaults to ten times step; retain approved F07 largeStep=10 unless the migration explicitly records a correction.

examples.finding: NumberField composes Slider and NumberInput using one application-level controlled value. NumberInput owns the supplied name. The example is composition evidence, not a complete partial-number or native-form specification.
Uses single-thumb arrays with numeric min/max/step, adjacent label/value display and ordinary Slider anatomy for independent parameters.

implementationImplications: Keep the approved single readonly numeric-array interface, native forms, TanStack ownership, Lit rendering, generated CSS and existing house motion roles.
Use thumbLabels for the configured per-thumb array so native labels remains NodeList; this is the delegated naming correction, to be persisted by the main implementation task.

Use NativeFormController for immediate submission, reset, restoration and disabled state; retain native range controls for platform semantics. Do not replicate Material renderValue shadow state as a second canonical value.
Preserve thumb identity and clamp between neighbors plus the gap. No new public push/swap/centered/inset-icon/stops/five-size interface is implied by reference coverage.

F07 standard and range behaviors remain distinct from Material Expressive appearance. Material discourages vertical ranges; recommend horizontal examples without silently deleting approved vertical capability.
Cancellation must be designed and tested explicitly. Proposed house rule is retain last live value, clear interaction, no commit; it is a delegated engineering choice, not claimed Material parity.
Preserve logical Tab order with optional numeric-input recipes, actual slider names/value text, endpoint contrast, visible focus, disabled behavior, forced colors and reduced motion.
acceptanceRequired: Source and compiled Chromium/Firefox/WebKit: immediate repeated FormData on assignment and inside input/change handlers; reset/default/restore/form reassociation and disabled Fieldset.
One/two/three thumbs with stable identity, names, focus, dynamic bounds, minimum gap, fractional minima, decimal/scientific steps and nonaligned maximum.
Horizontal LTR/RTL and vertical real-pointer movement; track jump, coincident thumb selection, captured movement outside bounds, competing pointer ignored.
Cancellation, lost capture, disable, disconnect, blur and programmatic replacement end the gesture with no later edits or false commit.
Native and custom keyboard paths emit one live/commit sequence, no duplicate change, and preserve Tab; actual accessibility-tree naming/value/orientation; external label activation.
HTML/Lit/React author-slot identity, Number Input composition, exactly one submitted value owner, light/dark and forced-color visual checks, reduced-motion cleanup.
limits: No house Slider source implementation, generator, build, native acceptance suite or assistive-technology certification was performed by this reference task.
Reference documentation videos were read by surrounding behavior text/captions, not measured frame by frame. No timing or motion-parity claim follows.

Specs and Accessibility figures were visually inspected; other illustrative examples were read with their descriptions. The related foundation snapshot is dated 2026-09-19 and was not freshly fetched.
Only Default Light and Default Dark common token contexts were expanded. Medium/high-contrast token-context permutations were not selected; forced-colors source was inspected separately.

General Lit runtime internals and the entire Sass system-token dependency graph were not audited. Slider behavior mixins, visual controllers, Slider styles and both relevant Slider token generations were fully read.
Material source behavior is not treated as browser proof. In particular native cancellation, focus, snapping, restoration and disabled semantics still need the listed acceptance cases.
Private Pro source stays outside the repository; the record contains paths, hashes and findings only.
retrievalNotes: Initial Firecrawl Specs response contained only a navigation fragment and is excluded from coverage. Isolated Chromium supplied the complete page and expanded token sets.
Chrome DevTools MCP could not start because its profile was already in use. The existing browser was not stopped; a separate temporary Playwright Chromium profile was used.
Early asynchronous token captures were one selection behind and were excluded. Final tokens-xsmall/small/medium/large/xlarge captures wait for the selected token content.
Lazy figure placeholders prevented some element screenshots. Full-resolution public source images were inspected separately; their URLs and content hashes are recorded.
